description: COMPLETED-session read-only enforcement. Backend: a single shared editable-session guard (assertSessionEditable) rejecting mutations to COMPLETED sessions, called from createCorrection (covers TEXT create/update/revert and SPEAKER_RENAME), addSpeakerLabel, deleteSpeakerLabel, and the post-consensus-resolve handler, using the AppError validationError (400) shape with the Japanese message 'このセッションは既に完了しているため編集できません。'. Frontend: propagate the session status to ReviewPage and make the COMPLETED review screen read-only (segment inline edit, speaker-label add/edit/delete, consensus-confirmed text edit, CONFLICT-origination suggestions, revert) while keeping TranscriptionDownload enabled. Independent of FEAT-002 (no code dependency between them; this feature is self-contained and can ship on its own).
steps: Create backend/src/utils/session-guard.ts exporting assertSessionEditable(session: SessionRecord): void that throws validationError('このセッションは既に完了しているため編集できません。') when session.status === 'COMPLETED' and returns void otherwise. Import validationError from '../utils/error-handler.js' and type SessionRecord from '../repositories/session-repository.js'.
Add backend/src/utils/session-guard.test.ts: COMPLETED throws an AppError with code 'VALIDATION_ERROR', statusCode 400, and the Japanese message; PENDING and IN_PROGRESS do not throw.

Add backend/src/utils/session-guard.property.test.ts using fast-check { numRuns: 100 }: describe title 'Feature: completed-session-readonly, Property 1: COMPLETED は常に編集不可', docstring '**Validates: Requirements 2.20**'; over an arbitrary status in {PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED} with random SessionRecord attributes, assert it throws iff status === 'COMPLETED'.

In backend/src/services/correction-service.ts createCorrection: before the timestamp/try block add `const session = await getSessionById(sessionId); if (!session) throw validationError('指定されたセッションが見つかりません。'); assertSessionEditable(session);`. Import getSessionById from '../repositories/session-repository.js' (same module addParticipant already comes from) and assertSessionEditable from '../utils/session-guard.js'.

Extend backend/src/services/correction-service.test.ts: COMPLETED → createCorrection throws 400 and saveCorrection is NOT called; IN_PROGRESS → saves as before (regression). Mock session-repository.js and correction-repository.js with vi.mock.

In backend/src/services/session-service.ts addSpeakerLabel and deleteSpeakerLabel: immediately after the existing getSessionById + notFoundError check, add `assertSessionEditable(session);`. Import assertSessionEditable from '../utils/session-guard.js'.
Extend backend/src/services/session-service.test.ts: addSpeakerLabel and deleteSpeakerLabel on a COMPLETED session → 400; IN_PROGRESS unchanged (regression).

In backend/src/handlers/post-consensus-resolve.ts: before the existing getSegment call add `const session = await getSessionById(sessionId); if (!session) throw notFoundError('指定されたセッションが見つかりません。'); assertSessionEditable(session);`. Import getSessionById from '../repositories/session-repository.js' and assertSessionEditable from '../utils/session-guard.js' (notFoundError is already imported). Do NOT add any new direct docClient calls.

Extend backend/src/handlers/post-consensus-resolve.test.ts: COMPLETED session → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; the existing non-COMPLETED CONFLICT-resolve success path still works (regression). Mock session-repository.js and dynamodb-client.js.

In frontend/src/pages/ReviewPage.tsx: add `sessionStatus?: ReviewSessionStatus` to ReviewPageProps (import ReviewSessionStatus from '../types/session'); add `const isReadOnly = sessionStatus === 'COMPLETED';`; change `editingEnabled` to `Boolean(onSaveCorrection) && !isReadOnly`, `suggestionEnabled` to `Boolean(onFetchSuggestions) && !isReadOnly`, `onRevert` prop to `{!isReadOnly && onRevertCorrection ? handleRevert : undefined}`, and gate the speaker-manager panel render with `{speakerManagerOpen && !isReadOnly && (...)}`. Add a role="status" toolbar note (e.g. '完了したセッションのため編集できません。') shown only when isReadOnly. Leave the TranscriptionDownload render condition unchanged. Add '2.18, 2.19' to the component JSDoc Requirements line.

Extend frontend/src/pages/ReviewPage.test.tsx (wrap in MemoryRouter, vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations() in each case): sessionStatus='COMPLETED' → no 確定/話者ラベル管理/候補/修正前に戻す UI, read-only role="status" note present, TranscriptionDownload still rendered; sessionStatus='IN_PROGRESS' → editing UI present (regression).

In frontend/src/App.tsx ReviewPageWrapper: add `const [sessionStatus, setSessionStatus] = useState<ReviewSessionStatus | undefined>();`, call `setSessionStatus(detailResult.value.data.session.status)` inside the existing detailResult.ok block, and pass `sessionStatus={sessionStatus}` on the <ReviewPage ... /> element. Import the ReviewSessionStatus type from './types/session' if not already imported.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && npx vitest --run` passes, including new session-guard unit+property tests and the added correction-service / session-service / post-consensus-resolve cases.
assertSessionEditable throws validationError (code VALIDATION_ERROR, statusCode 400, Japanese message) only for COMPLETED sessions.

POST /sessions/{id}/corrections, POST /sessions/{id}/speaker-labels, DELETE /sessions/{id}/speaker-labels/{label}, and POST /consensus/{id}/resolve all reject a COMPLETED session with the validationError shape; SPEAKER_RENAME (which flows through createCorrection) is covered.

In ReviewPage with sessionStatus='COMPLETED', inline edit/confirm, speaker-label management, suggestion, and revert UIs are absent while TranscriptionDownload remains rendered; a role="status" read-only note is shown; with 'IN_PROGRESS' the editing UI is unchanged.
`cd frontend && npx vitest --run && npm run build && npm run lint` passes (including vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations on the new ReviewPage read-only cases).
verification: cd backend && npm install (first time only) && npx vitest --run
cd frontend && npm install (first time only) && npx vitest --run && npm run build && npm run lint
findings:
Implemented as specified. Backend: `backend/src/utils/session-guard.ts` (assertSessionEditable) + unit + property tests; guard wired into createCorrection (correction-service.ts, with getSessionById + session-not-found validationError), addSpeakerLabel/deleteSpeakerLabel (session-service.ts), and post-consensus-resolve.ts (getSessionById + assertSessionEditable before getSegment, using notFoundError when the session is missing). Frontend: ReviewPage gains `sessionStatus?: ReviewSessionStatus`, derives `isReadOnly = sessionStatus === 'COMPLETED'`, gates editing/suggestion/revert/speaker-manager and shows a role="status" read-only note while leaving TranscriptionDownload rendered; App.tsx ReviewPageWrapper propagates `session.status` via new state.

Test-mock deviations (necessary because createCorrection and post-consensus-resolve now call getSessionById): (1) correction-service.test.ts and correction-service.property.test.ts had their `../repositories/session-repository.js` mock extended with `getSessionById` (editable default); the property test returns a stub IN_PROGRESS session. (2) post-consensus-resolve.test.ts now also mocks `../repositories/session-repository.js` with `getSessionById` (default IN_PROGRESS in beforeEach), so the handler's new session lookup does NOT go through the docClient mock — the existing mockSend sequences stay valid. (3) The COMPLETED post-consensus-resolve case asserts the segment query (mockSend) is never called.

Verification: `cd backend && npx vitest --run` => all pass (1147 passed, 85 skipped). `cd frontend && npx vitest --run` => all pass (1059 passed, 87 files). `npm run build` succeeds. `npm run lint` exits 1, but ALL 45 errors are PRE-EXISTING baseline unrelated to FEAT-001: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in useAuth.ts and in ReviewPage.tsx lines 141 & 336 (untouched by this change), plus @typescript-eslint errors in src/test-utils/vitest-axe.d.ts. My edits (ReviewPage sessionStatus/isReadOnly gating, App.tsx state propagation, session.ts unchanged) introduce no new lint violations — a targeted `eslint` run on the changed files reports only the two pre-existing effect lines. The lint baseline was already failing before this feature; no in-scope way to make `npm run lint` green without refactoring unrelated files.

For FEAT-002 (reopen): assertSessionEditable guards must NOT block the reopen path — reopen writes status directly via updateSessionStatus (not changeSessionStatus, whose VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS.COMPLETED=[] forbids it).
